<thought>The spectrum shows a series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly according to the binomial distribution expected for ^13C isotopes (M+1 ≈ 11 % of M, M+2 ≈ 0.1 % of M, etc.). No significant M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, or S is present. Thus the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
